Chilly Nelson's Co-Worker's Mom's Secret Hobo Staff of Hawt Hobo Power
Client type:  2H Staff
Class palette:  Mage
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

Chilly Nelson's Co-Worker's Mom's Secret Hobo Staff of Hawt Hobo Power is a named mythic item from the client file 2HStaffMythicPAL.gc (2HStaffMythic1000).

This is the base name. Rolled mythics can also append a suffix from Mythic Suffixes. Those endings change the last part of the name and add the bonus listed on that page. This page does not invent extra roll combinations.

The template sets SoulBound = true. 1st Edition Item Pack Exclusive
